findings.explanation: The agreement requires you to perform open-ended advisory services requested by the company without a formal change-order process or guaranteed extra pay, which can lead to unpaid extra work.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor agrees to perform the services specified on Schedule A, and any additional services requested by the Client shall be subject to a separate written change order detailing the additional work and compensation.

findings.explanation: Your intellectual property is assigned to the company immediately upon creation rather than upon receipt of payment, leaving you without leverage if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: Upon full payment for the applicable services, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in the deliverables specifically created under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have a few small suggestions before I sign. - Regarding the relevant clause on consulting services, the agreement requires open-ended tasks without a formal process for extra pay, which can lead to unpaid extra work; I propose that additional services be subject to a separate written change order detailing the work and compensation. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, the current terms assign my work immediately upon creation rather than upon payment, leaving me without leverage if payment is delayed; I propose that the assignment take effect upon full payment for the applicable services. Thank you for your time and understanding.
